title: Generated-UI design rubric: grades and measured facts
status: The grades are an AI judge's, not independent expert grades. The author reviewed the judge's grades on the first 11 items and marked every row agree. The items added after that are judge-only: the author has not reviewed them.

not_captured.why: P4 was published for capture, but the deployment held no files and returned a 404. Nothing could be captured.
P2 renders blank offline because it needs a backend. P3 to P6 were blocked by the free token cap and were not paid for.
